# Offline PDF dependency

pypdf 6.21.4, pure Python wheel from PyPI. BSD-3-Clause license and copyright notices are preserved inside the wheel (`pypdf-6.21.4.dist-info/licenses/`).

Upstream: https://pypi.org/project/pypdf/6.21.4/

SHA-256: `33e4fb41ca352810eb4e9838aa0d82d6888a5f8bf682f43e99cce5faa666255c`. Install with `python -m pip install --no-index --no-deps <wheel>` into the managed runtime only. No code compilation or package-index access is needed.
